name: hbfd_rly_136_sn-rr1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM R25GQ die relay family: hbfd_rly_136_SN, one register stage of width class 136 b (in S / out N, ck + rs W), 21.6 x 21.6 um, M5 cap, pins at 2 tracks on one layer a face, flops at the pins, minimum output delay at the pin (outhold); replaces the generated per-instance relay station placeholders of its class (tools/hbm_die_rly_kits.py --map)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hbfd_rly_136_SN u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/ot_hbm_rly.sv rtl/hbm_accel/die_glue/hbfd_rly_masters.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: exact_words
bench.pass_regex: RLY_BENCH PASS 0 errors in 20000 words .* release_edges=3 window_words=[1-9]

bench.name: neg_reset_relay_bypass_mutant
bench.fail_regex: RLY_BENCH FAIL [1-9]\d* errors in 20000 words .* release_edges=3

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_136_sn/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_136_sn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hbfd_rly_136_sn --out {RUN}/record/views/hbfd_rly_136_SN  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HBM-NATIVE5/RLY4 rr1 (2026-10-18): rs -> ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 = registered reset relay (rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv, 2 sync + 1 relay flop; tools/hbm_die_rly_kits.py RS_RELAY_MASTERS + hbfd_rly_136_SN) so the rs pin drives 3 flops instead of the async clear of all 136 stage flops (closed hbfd_rly_136_sn-v1-2d0c1a8ac: routed native capture rs 224.4 ps > 190, owners HBM native audit). Stage release 3 clock edges after rs (as the _fc variants since NATIVE-FIX3 and the > 256 b classes), assert async/immediate. Kit re-generated with the current recipe-2 pin defaults (hold_pad HB2xp67 instead of the implicit HB4xp67 output/input pad, pin_reg_split = one dedicated launch flop per o pin FIRM at the o face, OT_KEEP_PIN_REGS=1); outline 21.6 x 21.6, pin faces and pin plan unchanged; 0 data cycles.

reroute_reason.fix: ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 in hbfd_rly_136_SN (generator RS_RELAY_MASTERS; every other master byte-identical): rs drives the 3-flop registered reset relay, the relay drives the 136 stage clears; release +3 edges (bench_rly.sh REL 3 expected-o model; reset-relay-bypass mutant FAILs)
reroute_reason.why_route: owners HBM native audit (claude/owners-hbm-native-1018 61ccb4897, results/arch/owners_hbm_1018/owners_hbm_native_audit.json): hbfd_rly_136_SN rs capture 224.4 ps > 190 (rs = async clear of all 136 stage flops) in CLOSED hbfd_rly_136_sn-v1-2d0c1a8ac; bound in the d4g GEN1 plan (lane relays). kind rtl_change: the master's RTL changes (RS_RELAY=1).
